title: A warm home after necessary endings

captions.physics: Restoring hope through practical domestic support
captions.emotions: Feeling warmth in available domestic abundance

meaning: Your domestic support keeps its warmth when ending what is unnecessary accounts for present care and leaves both an available way to settle.
text: Hope for a warmer home may encourage you to help each other change familiar arrangements. The Star in the physical position of Muladhara appears through supportive participation. Death in energy can make an ending unnecessarily abrupt: remove the old immediately and completely. The Empress in emotions wants to feel warmth, fullness and available care. Clearing space therefore does not always bring the expected relief: an unnecessary part has gone, but something still providing comfort can be lost too quickly alongside it.

For example, you decide to give up bulky old furniture. Along with a wardrobe, you want to remove the familiar armchair and every small table although no new resting place exists yet. **An ending helps home when care for the present remains available.** The passage can be cleared while a comfortable seat stays for now; supporting the future does not require spending this evening in a space where neither can settle peacefully.

The difficulty is treating every retained object as an inability to release the past. Change becomes a test of decisiveness, and needing warmth looks like weakness. Support grows when an ending’s scale reflects what belongings actually do. Something still helping you live need not disappear alongside what is outdated; new arrangements can have a transition in which care remains tangible.
